contexts.text: Abram went according to his journeys... () = progression... ( = according to order. AC 1554.)
Journeys = further progressions; and as these are done according to order, journeys, here, = nothing else.
By the journeys or sojournings of Abraham and Jacob were represented the progressions into the truths of faith and goods of love...
By the journeys and wanderings of the sons of Israel... were represented... the temptations of the faithful.
